description: Move a contact to one of the four rings on the user's Connections map, which says how often they want to keep in touch: inner_circle is weekly, close is monthly, familiar is quarterly, network is yearly. Use it only when the user says so in plain words ('Dana is inner circle', 'move Sam to network', 'I talk to Lee every month'). Get object_id from search_graph_objects. What the user says wins over the suggested ring and sticks.
name: set_closeness
title: Move someone to a ring
